method.navigation: goto(waitUntil: networkidle, 120 s) → scroll to the bottom in steps of 60 % of the viewport, 150 ms apart → wait 1 s → inject *{content-visibility:visible!important} → measure at the bottom scroll position
method.visitor: anonymous, consent cookie sk_consent preset (no banner), empty cart
method.sharpCorners: visible box = (a) border on ≥ 3 sides, width > 0, non-transparent, different from the element's own effective background, OR (b) background-color alpha > 0.5 differing from the nearest ancestor's effective background, OR (c) img/video/canvas/input/select/textarea/button. Excluded: < 12 px in either dimension, boxes touching both viewport edges, html/body, nextjs-portal subtree, position:fixed touching a viewport edge, invisible (offsetParent null [fixed elements are measured], opacity 0 on self or ancestor, visibility hidden, display none, closed details). Square = all four computed corner radii are 0.
method.tagOnly: tagOnly = square elements counted only by criterion (c). inRoundedWrapper = an ancestor within 4 levels has a non-zero radius and either draws a box (a/b) or clips (overflow ≠ visible); ownPaint = the element paints 1–2 border sides itself; bare = neither.
method.fixedOffscreen: a position:fixed element lying completely outside the viewport (skip link before focus, parked bars) is treated as invisible together with its subtree
method.sharpWhy: why: border = criterion (a), bg = criterion (b) only, tag = criterion (c) only (element type, nothing drawn by border/background)
method.touch:
390 only. a[href], button, input:not([type=hidden]), select, textarea, [role=button], summary; visible; < 44 px in either dimension. Excluded: links inside

, links inside

  • that has text outside links/buttons, visually hidden (≤ 1 px / clip). count = the element's own box (as specified). countEffective = own box ∪ pointer-receiving absolutely positioned ::before/::after ∪ associated
method.type: 390 only. Text elements = visible elements with a non-empty direct text node. controlsBelow14 = input/select/textarea with font-size < 14 px plus text elements inside <button> < 14 px. fieldsBelow16 = text inputs/select/textarea under 16 px (iOS focus zoom threshold).
method.header: on / only: fresh load, measured at scrollY 0, after scrolling down to 1200 px (4 × 300) and after scrolling up 300 px (3 × 100); fixed elements listed after the up-scroll. fixedCheck on the other pages repeats the down/up scroll after the main measurement.
